title: [Bug 645022] UI improvements for report themes and header/footers (composite layout)
summary: Composite layout administration pages get UI improvements: page 9663 shows decoded part names, and page 9666 gains a Description column plus Replace, Edit description and Show info actions. Page 9668 adds a Description field, and page 9660 enables composite actions only for Word layouts.
key_points: Tenant Report Layout Cfg shows decoded part names instead of the raw guid::name value, display only
Report Theme and Header/Footer adds Description column, Replace, Edit description and Show info actions, with Replace and Part Status scoped to lines
New Report Theme Header/Footer page adds a Description field and is reused as the Edit Description dialog
Report Layouts enables Manage all themes/header-footers and Layout configuration only for Word layouts
Telemetry no longer includes the raw user-entered layout description
quote: UI improvements for the composite-layout (Document Report Experience) theme and header/footer administration, plus fixes for the automated review feedback.
